mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.title AS title, n.notice_type AS noticeType, COALESCE(n.published_at, n.created_at) AS baseDateTime, n.is_pinned AS isPinned, n.author_org_name AS authorOrgName, n.author_employee_name AS authorEmployeeName FROM notice n WHERE n.is_published = TRUE ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, COALESCE(n.published_at, n.created_at) DESC, n.notice_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n WHERE n.is_published = TRUE
AND n.notice_type = #{noticeType}

SELECT n.notice_id AS noticeId, n.title AS title, n.content AS content, COALESCE(n.published_at, n.created_at) AS baseDateTime, n.author_org_name AS authorOrgName, n.author_employee_name AS authorEmployeeName, n.notice_type AS noticeType FROM notice n WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.is_published = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT e.employee_id AS employeeId, e.employee_name AS employeeName, COALESCE(o.org_name, '-') AS orgName FROM employee e LEFT JOIN employee_hr_info h ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.org_id = h.org_id WHERE e.employee_id = #{employeeId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice ( title, content, notice_type, author_employee_id, author_employee_name, author_org_name, is_pinned, is_published, published_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{authorEmployeeId}, #{authorEmployeeName}, #{authorOrgName}, FALSE, TRUE, NOW(), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND is_published = TRUE
